  • Enum Constant Details

    • NullMotor

      public static final Motors NullMotor
      A null motor that can be used for testing or as a placeholder when no motor is needed.

      It has the same properties as a bag motor, but does not actually control any hardware.

    • newController

      public MotorController newController(String logPrefix, int deviceID)
      Returns a new MotorController implementation for this motor type.

      The newly created motor controller is configured with the default settings for the motor type. If you want to configure the motor controller with custom settings, call one or more of the apply() methods. As a convenience, the newController(String, int, MotorConfig, MotorCurrentConfig) method can be called instead to apply basic and electrical current configurations.

      Parameters:
      logPrefix - The prefix for the log entries.
      deviceID - The CAN device ID.
      Returns:
      A new MotorController implementation.
